origin.says: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 畺 (field boundaries) as the sound: reins. Simplified from 繮 by writing 糸 (silk) as 纟; the variant 韁 used 革 (leather).
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 亶 (sincere) as the sound: a hardwood tree, sandalwood.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 焦 (scorched) as the sound: a reef or rocks in the sea.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 粦 (will-o'-the-wisp) as the sound: phosphorus, the glowing mineral.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 尞 (bonfire, bright) as the sound: bright-eyed, seeing clearly, to understand; also to look from afar.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 童 (child) as the sound, and also for the sense: the little person seen in the eye, the pupil (like English 'pupil').
虫 (creature, insect) for the meaning plus 累 as the sound: a snail or conch shell, hence a spiral.

嚎.def: to cry loudly, to scream, to yell

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 豪 (heroic) as the sound: to howl, to cry out loudly.

嚎.name: scream

origin.says: 委 (entrust) as the sound with 鬼 (ghost), which may also give sound; first meaning 'lofty', now the name of the state of Wei and a surname.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; MakeMeAHanzi (they disagree on 鬼)

臊.def: shy, bashful; rank, fetid; the smell of urine

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 喿 (chirping) as the sound: the rank smell of fat and meat, also the smell of urine; later also shy.

臊.name: rank smell

origin.says: 鱼 (fish) for the meaning plus 咢 (shouting) as the sound: the crocodile, counted among water creatures. Simplified from 鰐 (a variant of 鱷) by the short fish radical.
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 康 (health) as the sound: rice husks, chaff, the old meaning of 康 itself.
Simplified from 鐮: 金 (metal) became 钅. 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 廉 (honest) as the sound: a metal blade for reaping, 'sickle'.
鱼 (fish) for the meaning plus 耆 (elderly) as the sound: the fin of a fish. Simplified from 鰭 with 魚 (fish) written in its short form.
玉 (jade) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: a flat jade ring or disc.

孽.def: bastard child; the consequence of a sin; evil

origin.says: 子 (child) for the meaning plus 薛 (marsh grass) as the sound: a child by a concubine; then evil, the fruit of sin.

孽.name: sin

origin.says: 艹 (grass, plant) for the meaning plus 磨 (millstone) as the sound: the mushroom.

蹭.def: to shuffle; to procrastinate, to freeload, to dilly-dally

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 曾 (once before) as the sound: to shuffle or rub along; now also to freeload.

蹭.name: rub along

ety.hint: The top 颠 of a mountain 山; 颠 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 颠 (top of the head) as sound and meaning: the top of a mountain, the summit.
Simplified from 癬: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 鲜 (fresh) as the sound: ringworm and similar skin disease.

ety.hint: A pleasing 美 lamb 羔 soup

origin.says: 羔 (lamb) over 美 (tasty): a tasty lamb broth, soup.
敝 (tattered) as the sound plus 鱼 (fish, water animal): the soft-shelled turtle. Simplified from 鱉 (魚 became 鱼).
髟 (long hair) for the meaning plus 宾 (guest) as the sound: the hair at the temples. Simplified from 鬢, where 賓 became 宾.
殸 (stone chime) as the sound plus 香 (fragrant) for the meaning: a fragrance that carries far.
虫 (insect, worm) for the meaning plus 需 (need) as the sound: moving like a worm, to wriggle.
One reading: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 魏 (Wei) as the sound; an older analysis takes 嵬 (high peak) with 委 (entrust) as the sound. Either way: towering, lofty.
origin.src: Dong Chinese; MakeMeAHanzi; own knowledge for the older analysis

origin.says: 鱼 (fish) for the meaning plus 粦 (will-o'-the-wisp) as the sound: fish scales. Simplified from 鱗 by writing 魚 (fish) as 鱼.
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 需 (need) as the sound: sticky, glutinous rice.

躏.def: to trample, to oppress; to overrun

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 蔺 (rush plant) as the sound: to trample. Simplified from 躪 by writing 門 as 门.

躏.name: stomp down

origin.says: 黑 (black) for the meaning plus 音 (sound) as the sound: deep black, dark and dreary.
骨 (bone) for the meaning plus 遀 (to follow) as the sound: the marrow inside bones, then the essence.

Bronze forms show 章 (jade ornament) with a holding hand, to bestow; the hand became 夂 (go slowly), and 贝 (shell) was added, which with a stroke reads as 贡 (tribute) for the sound. Now the name of Jiangxi. Simplified from 贛.
襄 (assist) as the sound plus 瓜 (melon) for the meaning: the soft flesh inside a melon, pulp.

ety.hint: Three people standing up straight 直

origin.says: Three 直 (straight) stacked: many things standing straight up, towering.
